newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-5 firms win Sydney 2000 merchanding contracts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-5 firms win Sydney 2000 merchanding contracts.

text.p: The Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games has awarded five companies with a licence to merchandise their products under the Sydney Olympic banner.

SOCOG president and New South Wales Olympics minister Michael Knight said Akubra Hats, Australian Weaving Mills, Coogi Australia, Driza-Bone, and R.M. Williams Holdings Ltd will be able to market their products using the Sydney Olympic logo from January 1, 1997.
The five companies have products across the ranges of apparel, textiles, knitted ware and accessories.
